item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":4,"rationale":"Vessels are presently made subject to supervision and controlling craft must display identification, while the Secretary is separately directed to enforce the order; the segment inseparably combines self-executing legal duties with executive enforcement direction.","evidence":"Movement of vessels or other craft within this area shall be at their own risk and shall be subject to supervision by controlling surface craft or aircraft."},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary or a designee is granted discretionary authority to prescribe future implementing regulations, without requiring any specified regulatory outcome.","evidence":"is hereby authorized to prescribe such regulations as he may consider necessary"},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"The provision itself presently subjects any violator of the order to the statutory penalties, creating the legal consequence upon violation without requiring a later agency decision.","evidence":"shall be subject to the penalties provided by section 2152 of Title 18 of the United States Code"}]}
